texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上的地质勘探揭示了这颗行星远比我们之前预想的更加富有矿藏。在调节了我们的传感器以后它便可以扫描更深的地下，发现了许多大有前景的矿场。我们应该委派更多的人力物力进行勘探，或许可以发现更深处的有用矿脉。
texts.en: Geological surveys on [Root.GetName] have revealed that the planet is richer in minerals than we thought. After calibrating our sensors to penetrate deeper into the ground, we have discovered several promising mining sites. Should we direct additional resources to probing efforts, we might yet uncover deeper veins of useful ore.

label.zh: 批准经费，进行深层勘探。

texts.zh: 探测[Root.GetName]的地下是一个冗长的过程：我们的探测器对地下构成的响应不佳，地质构造中的断层又使得我们需要频繁地调整仪器。然而，我们还是发现了更多值得开发的高价值矿石。它们的深度使得开采作业的后勤工作远复杂于往常，但无论如何这应该都是值得的。没有迹象表明进一步的了勘探作业可以让我们找到更多矿脉了。
texts.en: Probing the underground of [Root.GetName] is a tedious process: our scanners do not react well to the ground composition, and shifts in the geological layers mean that we have to recalibrate them every time. Still, we have discovered more exploitable veins of high quality ore. Their depths makes the logistics of the mining operation more complex than usual, but it will take more than that to stop us. There is no assurance that additional probing operations will lead us to more mineral veins.

texts.zh: 最近在[Root.GetName]的勘探作业几乎一无所获。我们所能找到的其他的矿藏全部都埋藏过深、储量不大，而且处于不稳定的地层当中。开采这些矿物的成本将会高于开采所得的利润。尽管如此，我们此前的发现已经表明此处的资源极其丰富，我们需要数十年乃至上百年的时间才能开发完毕。
texts.en: The latest prospecting efforts on [Root.GetName] were inconclusive. Whatever minerals we could detect were buried too deep, in too small quantities, and through unstable ground. The projected costs of exploiting these veins would be higher than the profits. Despite this, our previous findings represents an enormous source of resources that should keep us busy for decades if not centuries.

texts.zh: 无论在[Root.GetName]上的矿物藏得多深，我们都要找到它们，开采它们。我们一直就是这样的。其他人也许面对不稳定地层、令人望而却步的深度和采矿运输的后勤工作面前退缩，而我们绝不。底下世界就是我们的家园，只要找准方向定能有所收获。往下挖得越深，矿物的品质和储量就越高。我们最新的采样甚至表明了深层中稀有水晶的存在。
texts.en: No matter how deep the minerals on [Root.GetName] are hidden, we will find and extract them. It is what we do. Others might give up when confronted with unstable grounds, unfathomable depths or the logistics of maintaining transport tunnels, but we do not. The underground is our home, and if we know where to look, it will provide. The lower we go, the higher the quality and quantity of the ore. Our latest samples even hinted at the presence of rare crystals deeper.

label.zh: 我们已经找到够多了，开始开采吧。

texts.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的勘探队已经抵达了最新的深度。如预期一样，灯光所及之处，我们果然找到了一丛丛闪耀着橙色、黄色和红色的灵动光芒的晶簇。它们有的看起来如同照亮洞穴的火盆，在岩壁上投下斑驳的光影。我们还有一个谜一样的发现：如果以千年尺度来观测，这些晶体似乎在缓慢地向行星的地心移动。我们相信，如果向地心挖得更深的话我们一定会有更多发现。
texts.en: A new depth has been reached by our surveying expeditions on [Root.GetName]. As predicted, we are encountering clusters of crystals that shine in vivid hues of oranges, yellows, and reds when light passes through them. At times, it looks as if a brazier is illuminating the caves where we find them, casting shifting shadows on the walls. We also made a puzzling observation: it looks as if over the millennia, these crystals are slowly migrating towards the center of the planet. We are confident that there will be more to find if only we dig deeper towards the core.

label.zh: 这些勘探工作花销过高了。
label.en: These probing works are too expensive.
Then a digging we shall go.

texts.zh:
我们的勘探队往[Root.GetName]的深处进一步寻找矿石的过程中发现越来越多的水晶散布在他们的路径上。最终，他们抵达了接近[Root.GetName]核心的一个巨大洞穴，随后便失去了联系。他们最后的消息是正在搭建灯光和传感器以研究洞穴，然后就听到痛苦的尖叫，死亡和毁灭随之而来。

事故的原因很快被确定了，其他的地址勘探者探测到了多重的隧道回声正高速向我们的殖民地袭来。没过多久，恐怖的事情发生了，我们被一个硕大无比的晶态实体袭击。它看起来太空中的晶态实体别无二致，但更加具有侵略性，并且可以使用重构能力在一瞬间改变它们的身体形状。

以前我们用来安抚太空晶体的无线电信号都没有起作用。尽管晶态实体的核心还深埋于地下，但它分裂出许多触手一般的附肢正在破土而出，准备攻击我们同时吸收更多晶体生长。预期前景十分不妙，我们很快就能看到到[Root.GetName]上的殖民活动要到头了。
texts.en:
As our surveyors delved ever deeper to find ore on [Root.GetName], more and more crystals littered their paths. Finally, they reached a gigantic cavern located close to the core of [Root.GetName], and we lost communications. The last thing we know is that they were in the process of setting up lights and various sensors to study the cave. Then screams. Pain. Death. Destruction.

The cause was soon revealed when other geological surveyors detected multiple echoes tunneling at tremendous speed toward our colonies. Not long after, amid quakes and tremors, we were attacked by a crystalline entity of tremendous proportions. It is not unlike the spaceborne crystals, but seems to be highly aggressive, and capable of using the reconstructive capabilities of its kind to reshape its body in an instant.

 All attempts to deploy the radio signals that we use to pacify spaceborne crystals have failed. While the core of the crystalline entity remain buried deep, it spawned tentacle-like appendages that dug through the ground looking to attack us or to absorb more crystals to grow. Projections are grim and we might be looking at the end of our colony on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们的勘探队往[Root.GetName]的深处进一步寻找矿石的过程中发现越来越多的水晶散布在他们的路径上。最终，他们抵达了接近[Root.GetName]核心的一个巨大洞穴，随后便失去了联系。他们最后的消息是正在搭建灯光和传感器以研究洞穴，然后就听到痛苦的尖叫，死亡和毁灭随之而来。

事故的原因很快被确定了，其他的地址勘探者探测到了多重的隧道回声正高速向我们的殖民地袭来。没过多久，恐怖的事情发生了，我们被一个硕大无比的晶态实体袭击。它看起来太空中的晶态实体别无二致，但更加具有侵略性，并且可以使用重构能力在一瞬间改变它们的身体形状。

在太空中我们的舰队可以以高机动性和火力来取胜于这些晶体，但在行星上我们对它束手无策。尽管晶态实体的核心还深埋于地下，但它分裂出许多触手一般的附肢正在破土而出，准备攻击我们同时吸收更多晶体生长。预期前景十分不妙，我们很快就能看到到[Root.GetName]上的殖民活动要到头了。
texts.en:
As our surveyors delved ever deeper to find ore on [Root.GetName], more and more crystals littered their paths. Finally, they reached a gigantic cavern located close to the core of [Root.GetName], and we lost communications. The last thing we know is that they were in the process of setting up lights and various sensors to study the cave. Then screams. Pain. Death. Destruction.

The cause was soon revealed when other geological surveyors detected multiple echoes tunneling at tremendous speed toward our colonies. Not long after, amid quakes and tremors, we were attacked by a crystalline entity of tremendous proportions. It is not unlike the spaceborne crystals, but seems to be highly aggressive, and capable of using the reconstructive capabilities of its kind to reshape its body in an instant.

 It is one thing to face such an entity in space where our ships can bring their speed and weapons to bear, but another entirely to fight them planetside. While the core of the crystalline entity remain buried deep, it spawned tentacle-like appendages that dug through the ground looking to attack us or to absorb more crystals to grow. Projections are grim and we might be looking at the end of our colony on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的开采作业遇到了意外的困难，包括一些小规模的地震和晶体矿脉的位移，总之发生了一些什么奇怪的事情。穷尽我们所有关于开采的经验都无法解释到底是怎么回事。这些情况使得我们很难保证开采作业的安全，我们已经在一些无法预测的事故和塌方中损失了一些设备、人员和矿石。也许我们应该适可而止，在一定的深度停止采矿。
texts.en: Our mining operations on [Root.GetName] have encountered unexpected difficulties. Ranging from mild tremors to shifting crystal veins, something is going on. Despite all our experience in tunneling, we have no idea what it is. These circumstances make it hard to work in secure conditions, and we have already lost gear, lives and ore in unpredictable accidents and collapses. Perhaps it would be best to halt mining operations under a certain depth?
